# Montana Contracting
Montana Contracting is a general contractor based in Congers, NY, serving the Hudson Valley, New York, and New Jersey since 1984. The firm specializes in high-end residential and commercial construction, pre-construction services, and construction financing through a partnership with Procida Funding. Key offerings include:
- Pre-construction budgeting with proprietary NOVATERRA cost intelligence
- General contracting for residential and commercial projects
- Construction financing for multi-family, affordable housing, and large-scale commercial projects (via Procida Funding)
- Featured projects include: Piaule Catskill Retreat, Hudson River House, Germantown Compound, Twisted Ridge, The Gym Englewood, Palisades Mod Ranch, Dairyland Chef's Warehouse
- Contact: (845) 398-1778, info@montanacontracting.com, 173 N. Route 9W, Congers, NY 10920
- Website: https://montanacontracting.com
